_note: One reference character (the boy), 4 scenes for story 'Bin và bạn bè' (local DB 9e547721, 8 pages grouped 2 per scene). The grandmother is described in the scene text, not referenced. No real names.

characters.description: a 6-year-old Vietnamese boy with short black hair, wearing a blue T-shirt and dark shorts

scenes.description: Rainy afternoon inside a cozy Vietnamese home. The boy sits on a woven mat playing with a shiny red toy train on a long track around a chair. A kind grandmother with silver hair in a bun, round glasses and a brown ao ba ba walks over holding a small wooden train carriage. The boy hugs his red train tightly to his tummy, lips pressed, looking down.

Same room, rain outside the porch. The boy turns away and hides the red train behind his back, looking worried. The grandmother in a brown ao ba ba sits quietly in a corner of the mat, hands on her knees, shoulders slumped; the small wooden carriage lies alone on the mat.

Same room. The boy walks back to the grandmother holding the small wooden carriage and offers it to her with a shy smile. The grandmother in a brown ao ba ba and glasses looks up, eyes bright and happy.

Same room, the rain is fading outside. The boy and the grandmother laugh together as the red train with the wooden carriage goes through a tunnel made of a pillow; they sit close together on the mat, warm cheerful light.
